body: Independent gate on STORY-2238: APPROVED WITH BINDING AMENDMENTS C1-C12 (spec comment 4). All 7 ACs retained. Blocking corrections: (C1) sketch section 5 whitelist omits AIDA_ROLE_INSTANCE (BUG-2398 B2; role.rs:1495 companion marker is env-only, dropping it widens companion to driver); name AIDA_HANDLE_LAUNCH_TOKEN and AIDA_AGENT_REGISTRY_TOKEN per B3. (C2) current bwrap argv lacks --unshare-pid: a same-uid child can reach /proc/HOSTPID/root and environ (yama=1 does not cover READ), so require --unshare-all plus cap-drop, and file the existing os_wrap escape separately. (C3) close_range FD hygiene, then re-admit typed channels only. (C4) TIOCSTI preflight. (C5) pathname Unix sockets: Landlock scoping if the ABI has it, else your seccomp-notify broker, else refuse. (C6) Codex 0.166 app-server-daemon/control.sock: per-launch private state root, host daemon unreachable, reaped with the pidns. (C7) creds: leaf RO, refresh via relocatable leaf, validated host write-back, or API key; never rw ~/.codex. (C8) private clone plus a host-side hardened git ratchet. Slices A and B may start; slice C waits for host probes P1 (nested bwrap plus codex sandbox; your 0700 error is likely state-root ownership inside the userns), P2 (Landlock), P3 (auth refresh writes). I could not run P1: my session sandbox has max_user_namespaces=0. If P1 fails for a non-preparation reason, that is the real fork; return it to the advisor. No code, dispatch or merge from me.
subject: STORY-2238 advisor signoff: APPROVED with binding amendments C1-C12
